analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 94,535) above SMA5 (KRW 90,432), below SMA20 (KRW 96,530), below SMA50 (KRW 103,535): short-term strength weakening, mid-term trend turning bearish
· Below SMA100 (KRW 111,332), below SMA200 (KRW 100,571): long-term trend bearish
· 52-week position (41.2%) + current price level approaching historical low range
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 30.4 → 46.2 (exiting oversold): attempting to establish in neutral zone
· MACD histogram -1891.4355 → 318.1553 (improving): weakening bearish reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (KRW 94,535) below middle band (KRW 96,530): 39.26% band width suggests potential for increased volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 85,300): based on 52-week low
· Swing resistance (KRW 95,720): below Pivot R1 (KRW 110,545), expectation of trend reversal upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: sideways range, lack of direction
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio 1.18: moderate confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation phase, consider buying on breakout above KRW 95,720 resistance
